name: codegames
description: Learn programming languages from the ground up through interactive games.

scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:runner & npm run dev
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:api

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'gitleaks is not installed. Install it with: brew install gitleaks' >&2; exit 1; }; gitleaks git --pre-commit --staged --redact --no-banner && npm run typecheck
